I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

- **Source:** Tobias posted it in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is in that channel, so she could see the message herself.
- **One assumption:** Tobias was talking about "his dealer account," not Marrow Fieldworks by name. I matched them using a brain note from January 2026, which said Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and was changing hands on 5 Jan. The note didn't say who took it over; I inferred Tobias. I told Pree the link was my reading.
- **Status unknown:** the account files list came back empty, so I couldn't see where #8841 stands now. I suggested she check with Tobias before the call.
